tei:div.tei:p: rin chen grang sbyor ril nag gi kha skong ldum sman gyi man ngag bzhugs so// ༈ /sman gyi bla dang yon tan mgon// mnyam nyid rdo rje la btud nas// rin chen grang sbyor kha skong ba'i// ldum sman zab khyad can 'ga' bstan// rin chen grang sbyor yod na yang*// ldum sman 'di rnams med gyur na// dper na dpa' bos dgra 'dul yang*// mtshon rnon med na de lta min// des na gnad 'di yod gyur na// sbyor ba dpung ldan rno la myur// 'di med nus mthu mi myur bul// de phyir 'di rnams ril nag la// cha snyoms zhib btags bsre bar bya// brag las byung ba'i rin chen brag zhun zhu1 na// 'dab chags khyung sder rgyal po'i sder smu2 ga dang*// pu tse she3 la hong len dang par+pa 4ta/ ldum bu bai ḍū5 r+ya sngo spyi bzhur mdog dang*// be do 6 spang rtsi do bo ut+pa7la la dang ni/ zhang blon ldum bu stag sha mu men ga8 sha can// 'dre mo'i yungs 9kar sgong thog rtsi mar 10rkang re skon pa// phu11 ra mong dang ni lca12gas kyu lhog dug nag po can// gser gyi me to13ga ti14ga ta dang*// stong zi15la tang ku16na da lis17 dang*// pri yang 18 ku dang 19snya lo dang*// shu20ga tsher rnams ni zhib btags te// grang sbyor sman nag che steng bsnan// des na ril nag gzhung gi sman// brgyad cu rtsa gsum yod pa la// 'di ltar kha skong ldum bu'i sman// nyi shu tham pa bsnan byas pas// sman sna brgya phrag gcig dang gsum// yod nges yin phyir khyad du 'phags// kha skong med na gzhung sbyor rdugs| |mkhas pa 'ga' zhig grang sbyor la// sman sna brgyad cu rtsa gsum yod// ces par smra ba blun tshig ste// kha skong nyi shu med phyir ro// 'dir ni gdams pa'i khungs bcad nas// ril nag grang sbyor chen mo la// gzhung dang kha skong bsdoms pa na// sman sna brgya dang gsum yod pa// 'phyugs med gnad kyi gdams pa yin// 'di las mang nyung byung ba na// sbyor ba 'di ni 'chol ba yin// des na grangs nges yod pa'i phyir// rang bzo kha bsgyur bya mi nyan// zhes pa 'di'ang dpal ldan zur mkhar ba dharma swa mi'i man ngag zab khyad can mang po las byung ba ltar/
dge slong dharma kīrtis sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
